messages:
serena: FYI I'm opening a docs PR to standardize audit-log field mappings for the v2 migration. Need quick eyes from legal + infra. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 :eyes:

matt: Thanks — can you include a small before/after mapping table and one concrete example payload for curl + python? Also call out which fields may contain PII and our redaction recommendation.

serena: Yep — will add mapping and an example. For PII guidance I'm planning: "mark for redaction at ingestion, store redaction metadata in audit_event.redaction". Is that wording ok?

elaine: Legal prefers we avoid "auto-delete" phrasing. Use: "retention TTL (customer-configurable); events expired by TTL are eligible for deletion per customer policy". That clarifies we don't presume deletion behavior.

michael: One quick technical note: in the current telemetry we have both user_id and actor_id in some systems. Suggest we standardize on actor_id for actors and add user_id as legacy alias + mapping example.

serena: Good call. I'll include mapping snippet like: 

```json
{
  "pre_migration": { "user_id": "u_123", "actor": "svc_abc" },
  "post_migration": { "actor_id": "svc_abc", "aliases": { "user_id": "u_123" } }
}
```

serena: Draft PR description will also list retention options (30/90/365 days) and a small table of sample queries for exports.

docs-bot: PR #789 opened by serena — review requested: @matt @elaine @michael.

matt: Quick nit — under "redaction" section add an example of a redaction marker for SDKs. e.g., "\"value\": \"<REDACTED:reason=pii>\"". Helps integrators replicate behavior.

elaine: Also add a short blurb for audit-readers: "When requesting data for legal holds, contact security-compliance; we can provide retained copies per policy. Do not promise indefinite retention."

serena: Will add both the SDK redaction example and legal blurb. One more ask: can eng-infra confirm sample TTL behavior for dedicated infra? @michael?

michael: On Dedicated we enforce customer-configured TTL on the index. We also have a retention-export path for e-discovery — I'll add a note about export latency (up to 48h).

serena: Perfect. Plan: update PR with mapping table, curl + python snippets, SDK redaction example, TTL wording per legal, and an infra note about export latency. Ping again when updated. :thumbsup:

matt: I'll review once you push updates.

elaine: LGTM pending wording tweak on "eligible for deletion" -> "subject to deletion per customer policy".

serena: Noted. Updating now.
